events.verdict: Sanders (LAC) initiates contact with Edgecombe's (PHI) left arm, which affects his play at the basket.
Sanders (LAC) establishes himself in Grimes' (PHI) path prior to the contact.
Grimes (PHI) makes contact with the ball, and with the part of Harden's (LAC) hand that is on the ball, as he defends the pass.
Drummond (PHI) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Edgecombe (PHI) initiates contact with Collins' (LAC) arm that affects his shot near the rim.
Collins (LAC) is already in Grimes' (PHI) path when contact occurs during the pick.
Grimes (PHI) contests Harden's (LAC) jump attempt and gives Harden space to land following the shot attempt.

Replay review of the foul called on Drummond (PHI) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Zubac (LAC) committed a proximate foul, re-routing Drummond into Sanders (LAC). A loose ball foul is assessed to Zubac, and play resumed with PHI free throws because LAC was in the penalty.
Sanders (LAC) and Edgecombe (PHI) come together at the same spot in pursuit of the loose ball, and the contact is marginal.
Zubac (LAC) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Edgecombe (PHI) does not establish a legal guarding position in Sanders' (LAC) path and initiates body contact that affects Sanders' driving shot attempt.

Replay review of the foul called on Dunn (LAC) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Dunn's contact to Maxey's (PHI) body was marginal, and Maxey lost control of the ball because it made contact with Batum's (LAC) knee, not because of the contact.  LAC was awarded possession because Dunn had possession at the point of interruption.
Grimes (PHI) makes contact with Harden's (LAC) left arm, which affects his jump shot attempt.
Sanders (LAC) cleanly dislodges the ball from Maxey (PHI) during rebounding.
Grimes (PHI) avoids making any contact with Harden (LAC) as he contests the jump shot.
